scripts.contracts:generate: npm run contracts:openapi && npm run contracts:types
scripts.contracts:check: npm run contracts:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts
scripts.firebase:test-api: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-gemmapunks --only auth,firestore "node scripts/seed_firebase.mjs --project demo-gemmapunks --verify && pytest -q apps/api/app/tests/test_ingestion_firestore.py apps/api/app/tests/test_backend_firestore.py"
scripts.firebase:seed-emulator: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-gemmapunks --only auth,firestore "node scripts/seed_firebase.mjs --project demo-gemmapunks --verify"
scripts.firebase:reset-emulator: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-gemmapunks --only auth,firestore "node scripts/seed_firebase.mjs --project demo-gemmapunks --reset --verify"
